27899.title: Neptune
27899.description: Lord of the waves, Neptune's wrath and favour ebb and flow like the tides. Devotees of Neptune fearlessly cruise the waves, exemplars of the sea god's courage.

27900.title: Minerva
27900.description: Minerva, divine avatar of wisdom, is master and patron of a thousand arts. Devotees of Minerva aim to live up to her lofty ideals of weaving, writing and winning.

43594.title: Ceres
43594.description: Ceres, august mother of fields, extends her divine grace to farmers, mothers and marriages. Devotees of Ceres fervently till soil, bolstered by blessings from her divine helpers.

50242.title: Cernunnos
50242.description: Cernunnos, horned lord of the forest, sits on the boundary between the civil and the wild. Devotees of Cernunnos can work alongside anything - man, beast or deity - to spin harmony out of contradiction.

50311.title: Mercury-Lugus
50311.description: Celtic adherents of Lugh found common ground with Roman Mercury, patron gods of crafts and trades alike. Devotees of Lugus and Mercury are dedicated to their work; to turning a profit, even more so.

80562.title: Mars
80562.description: Bloody-handed god of war, Mars presides over the violent art of warfare. Mars expects victory, and his devotees will do their utmost to make that happen.

80861.title: Epona
80861.description: Epona captured the hearts of Rome's cavalry, galloping her way across the Empire from her home in Albion. Now Romans, Celts and many others turn to her for equine guidance. Her devotees embody the free, wild spirit of the Great Mare.

144800.description: Down in the deep fires that built the world, Vulcan tends to his forge. His iconoclasts delve deep, and ever deeper, in hopes to hear the echoes of his divine hammer.
